label: Literature Review Assistant
description: Conduct systematic or narrative literature reviews: identify key sources, synthesise findings, map research gaps, and structure thematic analysis across scholarly works.

guidedInputs.label: Review Type
guidedInputs.description: What type of literature review are you conducting?

guidedInputs.label: Research Question(s)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. What is the effectiveness of AI-based transaction monitoring systems in detecting money laundering compared to rule-based approaches?

guidedInputs.label: Academic Discipline / Field
guidedInputs.description: Which academic field or interdisciplinary area?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Financial criminology, regulatory technology, computational compliance, law & technology...

guidedInputs.label: Inclusion / Exclusion Criteria
guidedInputs.description: Define the scope of sources to include.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Peer-reviewed articles 2018-2024, English language, focusing on EU/EEA jurisdictions, excluding opinion pieces...
